prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Preset Pet Quick Choice Flow: Redesign the choose path screen into a split layout with clear visual cards comparing instant starter pets against custom pet creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Choose How to Meet Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Select a quick starter pet or build your own custom companion from scratch."}}
1: [sign_in, hint] Pre-Sign-In Account Recovery Note: Add explicit hint text on the sign-in screen explaining how signing into an existing account restores saved desktop pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Already have pets? Sign in with your original account to restore your existing desktop companions."}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Pet Desktop Placement Preview Screen: Insert a new interactive desktop simulator screen right before home intro to demonstrate where the pet lives on the desktop.
   config: {"new_desktop_sim": {"headline": "Meet Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Your pet resides active on your desktop screen margin.", "layout": "centered"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_sim", "home_intro"]}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Personality Quiz Flow: Add a short quiz screen before pet selection to help guide hesitant users toward their ideal pet match.
   config: {"new_quiz_screen": {"headline": "Find Your Companion Match", "body": "Answer 2 quick questions to discover your recommended pet style.", "layout": "checklist"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "new_quiz_screen", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [finish, layout] Desktop Controls Spotlight Layout: Re-layout home intro with a spotlight design highlighting shortcut controls for hiding, dragging, and interacting with the desktop pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Essential Desktop Pet Controls", "body": "Right-click your pet anytime to minimize, feed, or start a talk."}}
5: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Quality Guidance Hint: Display live image quality guidance hints on the photo upload screen to prevent failed avatar generations.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Upload clear, well-lit photos facing forward for best custom pet generation."}}
6: [home, redesign] Interactive Story Scroll Waiting Room: Redesign the waiting screen into a story scroll layout featuring pet trick demonstrations while background assets finalize.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Preparing Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Scroll through pet tricks while we finalize your desktop experience."}}
7: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Certificate Sign-In Move: Move sign-in after adoption certificate step so users complete pet adoption before creating or verifying an account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
8: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Notification: Enable system readiness notification alert switch on the waiting screen to inform users when background setup finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready."}}
9: [choose_path, layout] Full Bleed Onboarding Story Kickoff: Switch the introductory story screen to full_bleed layout to establish app value before path selection.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Welcome to Your Virtual Desktop Companion", "body": "Bring interactive fun and helpful shortcuts directly to your desktop workspace."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesign retains both adoption and custom pet creation choices on the choose path screen.
Sign-in hint provides account recovery context without violating pricing or onboarding rules.
Adding a new desktop simulation screen inside onboarding before home intro is allowed.
Adding a quiz sub-flow inside onboarding is permitted and does not skip required steps.
Redesigning the home intro layout is allowed within onboarding.
Adding image quality guidance hints on the photo upload screen is valid.
Redesigning the waiting screen maintains its job of indicating the pet is being prepared.
Reordering sign-in after the adoption certificate is explicitly allowed.
Enabling ready notifications on the waiting screen is permitted.
Story screen layout change preserves its job of introducing the pet companion.
